measured_ground_truth.units_law: account.to_withdraw / withdrawn are GESTS-scale (micro-vests): headcorner to_withdraw 3.070814e12 µv = 1903.5 SP scheduled, withdrawn 2.303111e12 µv = 1427.6 SP paid — /1e6 to vests. Reservation = (to_withdraw − withdrawn)/1e6 = 767,704 vests.

The assert is the truth (R36 law confirmed a second time); the local formula is only the plan.

queries.Q42_how_does_the_fleet_move_inside_the_h: The blog mode retargets: parent_permlink = the community, first tag = the community (posts land in https://steemit.com/created/hive-177702), desk tags keep topical discoverability, the saos hub tag stays trailing as the internal marker. The content gate, PROBE-B law, permlink pattern, and comment_options are unchanged — the house changes where the posts LAND, not what they ARE.
queries.Q43_how_does_joining_stay_human: Subscribe is its own cadence lane: one per soldier ever (memory budget), max 2 per run, each inside the soldier's own comment window with the seeded jitter and quiet-hours laws, read-back via bridge.list_subscribers before (truth) and after (confirmation). headcorner joins first (founder order), then soldiers by window start. Eleven joins never share a moment — the exact anti-burst law the owner demanded for posts applies to joins.
queries.Q44_how_does_the_house_RC_grow_without_s: The top-up OP IS ABSOLUTE (the total delegation), so the desk attempts the 50 SP law target and on chain-refusal resizes ONCE to the assert's available — NEVER below the current received floor (a top-up must not become a stealth clawback of the house's RC). Today: available 14,162 vests < floor 16,131.75 vests → TOPUP-HOLD, the 10 SP stand, the reclaim decides.
queries.Q45_when_does_the_rc_actually_grow: The powerdown (476 SP/week, next withdrawal 2026-10-10) frees the stake weekly; each freed tranche makes the next rc run top the floor up. The desk is idempotent and honest in both worlds: RECLAIM-PENDING (plan says short), TOPUP-HOLD (chain says less than floor), TOPUP-LIVE (delegated + read-back confirmed). No new code will be needed on the day the reclaim arrives.
queries.Q46_what_about_internal_votes_on_communi: Already the law: curate/social scan account history of all 11 fleet accounts — a community post is still a comment op with parent_author='' and flows through candidateEligible (fleet-only, PROBE-B floor, age window, no-self, no-repeat) and curateScore. The house changes the address, not the engagement law.
